# gif.js 0.2.0

Unmodified browser distributions from the pinned npm package:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gif.js@0.2.0/dist/gif.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gif.js@0.2.0/dist/gif.worker.js
